messages.subject: Interactive plots - JGR
messages.body_plain:
Very nice package.  In particular, it reduces the pain of using
ggplot2. I was just trying to teach some folks how to use ggplot2 an
got a lot of blank stares.  Deducer makes it easy for the user to
create the plots and then gets the code that they can modify or add to
a script.  Nicely done!

I watched the video tutorials and have worked out most of what I
need.  I watched the iplots tutorial and was intrigued to use it but I
don't find it on the menus when running from RGUI.  Do I need the JGR
interface to get the interactive plot feature?  When I went to install
jgr.exe from the website, Norton Security suite identified it as a
potential threat and deleted it after downloading.  Do I need to turn
off Norton to install the software or am I doing something wrong?

Below is my sessionInfo.  I downloaded the development version but
that didn't help.

regards --jeff

messages.subject: Re: Java error
messages.body_plain:
In my impression the problem is related to DeducerExtras-Paired test.
In fact, this tool doesn't update data frames created during the
session. So, when you re-start JGR there is not matching between data.
You can try to load DeducerExtras and then create a new data frame.
This data frame doesn't appear in the menu when you open Extras>Paired
test. Now, if you save session and restart JGR loading the .Rdata file
created, you can generate the error trying to open Extras>Oaired test.
Thanks
Luciano

messages.body_plain:
Thanks for your prompt reply on my last post regarding iplot.  I'll
load up JGR interface.  In trying to get iplot to work I updated to
the development version on Rforge to see if that was the problem under
Rgui interface.  When I went to use open data this morning, it opened
the file selection box but upon selecting the file nothing happened.
I went back to the version on CRAN and it works again.  Just letting
you know that this may be a problem.  Below is my sessionInfo when it
works.

Thanks again for a very nice package. It will be very helpful in
getting non-programmers into R.  I've tried teaching beginners using
the standard approach of teaching the syntax and programming concepts
and it isn't particularly effective with the biologists that I work
with.  Having a Deducer as an interface will enable them to use R
without first learning the syntax.  They often get put off, don't get
into it and then forget what little they learned.  With Deducer they
can then start using it right away and learn the syntax as they go.

regards --jeff

messages.subject_clean: JGR not working for Mac Snow Leopard R64 2.12.1
messages.body_plain:
I really enjoyed Deducer and have explored the nice interface on my
windows computer. However, it doesn't work in my Snow Leopard Macbook.
Every time I open JGR launcher, I can see the interface for 1 sec and
it immediately closes itself. I have read the information on JGR
website about the special issue of snow leopard (http://www.rforge.net/
JGR/jgr_sl.html). But it didn't help.

Here is what I have done:
1. Install R-2.12-branch-leopard.pkg from http://r.research.att.com/
2. Download 64-bit JGR launcher from Download Page (JGR-1.6-SL.dmg)
3. Open R64
4. install.packages(c("rJava","JavaGD","iplots"))
5. install.packages(c("JGR","Deducer")
6. Click on JGR launcher

Any suggestions will be appreciated!

Thanks!
